name: Linghangzhe No. 1
summary:
Linghangzhe No. 1 (领航者1号) is the Zhejiang Humanoid Robot Innovation Center's first-generation full-size prototype, identified in its development timeline in March 2024. The center describes 39 degrees of freedom and an emphasis on stable walking over longer distances.

The platform formed part of its work on humanoid motion control and integrated robot systems. It should be distinguished from Linghangzhe No. 2, whose later design has a different joint count and a stronger stated emphasis on embodied manipulation tasks.
